writer.text: To avoid rebuilding unchanged map regions, PatchMap reuses existing cells and updates those touched by new observations during indoor robot navigation. On 120 matched trials with the same perception backbone, mean map-update time is 12 ms versus 28 ms for full rebuilding, while observed task success is 81% versus 82%. The measured computational benefit concerns map updating rather than end-to-end navigation latency.
